cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI in C# video on the Agent Framework Toolkit, which is a series of NuGet packages I've made to
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Agent Framework Toolkit 的 C# AI 影片；這是一組我製作的 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: make Agent Framework easier to work with.
cues.zh: 用來讓 Agent Framework 更容易使用。

cues.en: In the previous video, we saw about easier agents.
cues.zh: 上一支影片介紹了如何簡化代理程式。

cues.en: Now we're going to look at easier tools.
cues.zh: 現在來看如何簡化工具。

cues.en: So, if we look at our sample repository here, we have something called Agent Framework Toolkit,
cues.zh: 範例儲存庫的 Agent Framework Toolkit 底下，

cues.en: easier tools.
cues.zh: 有一個 Easier Tools 範例。

cues.en: And all we need to do when we work with tools is, of course, that we need to get a list of tools out.
cues.zh: 使用工具時，當然需要先取得工具清單。

cues.en: And if we were to do it this, the regular way, and we had a set of tools like this, where we have 10
cues.zh: 如果採取一般做法，而且有一組像這樣的工具，共十個，

cues.en: different tools to do file system work, like getting folders, creating folders, moving files and stuff, we would end up writing some code like
cues.zh: 用來處理檔案系統，例如取得、建立資料夾、移動檔案等，最後就必須寫出，

cues.en: this.
cues.zh: 這樣的程式碼。

cues.en: So we would new up our objects, and then we would use the AI Function Factory Create in order to take the various delegates
cues.zh: 先建立物件，再使用 AIFunctionFactory.Create，把各個委派，

cues.en: here, and put in a name and a description.
cues.zh: 轉成工具，並提供名稱與描述。

cues.en: We could, of course, begin to use reflection here in order to do this, but then it will be more difficult to get some good names and descriptions in.
cues.zh: 當然可以開始使用反射，但那樣比較難補上好的名稱與描述。

cues.en: So, if we instal the Agent Framework Toolkit, all we need to do is make a
cues.zh: 安裝 Agent Framework Toolkit 後，只需要建立，

cues.en: new instance of AIToolsFactory, or if you use dependency injection, builder.services.AIToolsFactory, and then you
cues.zh: 新的 AIToolsFactory；如果使用相依性注入，也可以透過 builder.Services 加入 Factory，接著，

cues.en: just say GetTools.
cues.zh: 直接呼叫 GetTools。

cues.en: And GetTools have two overloads.
cues.zh: GetTools 有兩種多載。

cues.en: You can either get it by types, or by instances.
cues.zh: 可以依型別取得，也可以依執行個體取得。

cues.en: So if you have a tool like this, where we don't have a constructor, our parameterless constructor, it is possible to just get the
cues.zh: 如果工具類別像這樣，沒有額外建構子參數，或有無參數建構子，

cues.en: tools by type of object, and what it does is it will go in here, and
cues.zh: 就能直接根據物件型別取得工具；它會進入類別，

cues.en: then will look for attributes.
cues.zh: 尋找相關屬性標記。

cues.en: So these are attributes you can put on your tools, where you can write the name and the description.
cues.zh: 你可以在工具方法上加入這些屬性，指定名稱與描述。

cues.en: And both name and description are optional, so if you just want to quickly have them, you can just put AITool, and it will use this as the name.
cues.zh: 名稱與描述都可以省略，所以快速測試時，只標上 AITool，就會用方法名稱作為工具名稱。

cues.en: But if you want to do it right, you put in a name and a description as well.
cues.zh: 不過正式使用時，最好也提供適當名稱與描述。

cues.en: So all I've done to this class is I've decorated the 10 tools with the AITool
cues.zh: 我對這個類別所做的，只是替十個工具加上 AITool，

cues.en: attribute, and then everything just comes out as tools.
cues.zh: 屬性，之後就能一次取得所有工具。

cues.en: Had my file system tools here needed things in the constructor via dependency injection, I would
cues.zh: 如果檔案系統工具的建構子需要透過相依性注入取得服務，

cues.en: need to new up the instance instead, or get a dependency injection version, and then I can just put in the instance instead.
cues.zh: 就必須先建立執行個體，或從 DI 容器取出，再把執行個體傳入。

cues.en: And if I had multiple objects, so for example, if the AITool factory itself had some tools, I could put in just multiple objects
cues.zh: 如果有多個物件，例如 Factory 本身也有工具，也可以一次傳入多個物件，

cues.en: for various different tool classes you had.
cues.zh: 取得不同工具類別中的工具。

cues.en: So much, much more simpler with a one -liner plus putting in these attributes so the data is actually closest to the real data
cues.zh: 所以只要一行呼叫，加上方法上的屬性，就能完成；名稱與描述也能緊鄰實際程式碼，

cues.en: instead of putting in multiple places.
cues.zh: 不必分散到好幾個地方。

cues.en: But we can go beyond that because this can also work with MCP tools, in that if you add one more NuGet package, agent
cues.zh: 功能還不只如此，也能支援 MCP 工具，只要再加入一個 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: -framework-toolkit.tools.modelcontextprotocol, it will now be able to work with remote tools and local tools.
cues.zh: AgentFrameworkToolkit.Tools.ModelContextProtocol，就能使用遠端與本機工具。

cues.en: So that would be that you simply say AITools factory, and then you get two extension methods on it.
cues.zh: 加入後，AIToolsFactory 就會多出兩個擴充方法。

cues.en: I didn't want to put it in the raw, so you wouldn't have a dependency on MCP unless you already used it.
cues.zh: 我沒有把它直接放進基礎套件，避免未使用 MCP 的應用程式也得相依於 MCP。

cues.en: So with this way, we can simply get tools from either remote or a local.
cues.zh: 這樣就能直接從遠端或本機 MCP 取得工具。

cues.en: And if you want to get it from a remote, we would need to give a remote MCP URL or the entire transport options if you want to do something more advanced.
cues.zh: 如果是遠端，提供 MCP 網址即可；需要進階設定時，也能傳入完整的 TransportOptions。

cues.en: But in my case, it's a MCP server that I do not have anything that needs to be done extra.
cues.zh: 我的範例 MCP 伺服器不需要額外設定。

cues.en: But if I had, for example, an API key, I could give it in a dictionary.
cues.zh: 但如果需要 API 金鑰，也可以透過 Dictionary 傳入。

cues.en: Or if I had some local tools, I would just simply need to go in and give my command.
cues.zh: 如果是本機工具，就只需要提供啟動指令。

cues.en: In many cases, it's just npx, and then the tool we wanted to do as arguments.
cues.zh: 很多情況是 npx，再把工具套件當成參數。

cues.en: In this case, it's Playwright.
cues.zh: 這裡使用的是 Playwright。

cues.en: So if we set some breakpoints here, let's set it up here so we can see it.
cues.zh: 我們在這裡設幾個中斷點，來看看。

cues.en: So if we wanted the tools, right now we have the tools by making them manually.
cues.zh: 目前這些工具，是透過手動方式建立的。

cues.en: But if we want to just get them via 18 Framework Toolkit, we can get them
cues.zh: 如果改用 Agent Framework Toolkit 取得工具，

cues.en: in exactly the same manner, either as type or instance, same deal.
cues.zh: 同樣可以依型別或執行個體取得，結果相同。

cues.en: And then if we wanted MCP tools, we could simply use this extra extension method in
cues.zh: 如果要使用 MCP 工具，只需要這個額外的擴充方法，

cues.en: order to get the tools.
cues.zh: 就能取得工具。

cues.en: So it now remotely went up to the remote MCP and found the tools and the information about them.
cues.zh: 它會連到遠端 MCP，取得工具與相關描述。

cues.en: And then if we want to do local tools using npx, we would get those tools back, in this case all the different tools
cues.zh: 如果要透過 npx 使用本機工具，也會取得對應的工具，這裡就是，

cues.en: from Playwright.
cues.zh: Playwright 的所有工具。

cues.en: And then it's just using the tools, in my case the file tools, and I could say create 10 files with random fruit names.
cues.zh: 接著直接使用即可；例如我提供檔案工具，要求建立十個以隨機水果命名的檔案。

cues.en: And I would end up in my test class with this.
cues.zh: 程式就會進入這個測試類別。

cues.en: That will begin to make some tools that are called GetRootFolders and so on, create the files, end up with 10 files in my
cues.zh: 開始呼叫 GetRootFolders 等工具，再建立檔案，最後在我的，

cues.en: local tool.
cues.zh: 本機資料夾中出現十個檔案。

cues.en: So that's everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 整體做法就是這些。

cues.en: Don't sit and do this by yourself when you can do it so much easier with the 18 Framework Toolkit like this.
cues.zh: 既然 Agent Framework Toolkit 可以讓事情變得這麼簡單，就不用每次從頭自己寫。

cues.en: So we're done.
cues.zh: 這支影片就到這裡。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
